newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania one-week rate rises to 53.33 pct vs 51 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania one-week rate rises to 53.33 pct vs 51 pct.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Friday heavy demand for its one-week refinancing funds had pushed the average accepted rate up to 53.33 percent from last week's 51 percent.
At Thursday's auction, four banks bid 1.501 trillion lei, exceeding the BNR's offer of 1.05 trillion lei. The four entered bids at prices ranging from 51 to 54 percent.
Traders said the rise of the BNR auctioned rate along with a rush for leu funds might trigger an upward move of short-term money market prices, which traded now at around 50 percent.
